skill: Traditional Origami Crane: Petal Fold & Corner Alignment

knowledge_package.title: Bird Base Petal Fold Crease Inversion Sequence
knowledge_package.summary: Transform square paper base through precision preliminary folds into the inverted petal fold bird base.

claims.statement: Crease diagonal valley folds and orthogonal mountain folds, then collapse into a 1/4 size preliminary square with open corner facing learner.
Lift top flap upward while simultaneously reversing lateral mountain creases into valley folds along the central symmetry axis.

rubric.title: Origami Geometric Alignment & Fold Direction Rubric
rubric.description: Deterministic scoring of corner vertex alignment, mountain/valley fold fidelity, and paper bias.

criteria.name: Corner vertex tolerance (< 1.0mm)
criteria.description: Opposite paper corners align within 1.0mm tolerance during diagonal creases.
criteria.observable_indicator: Visible gap between overlaying paper corners <= 1.0mm.

criteria.name: Mountain vs valley crease vector fidelity
criteria.description: Petal fold side creases are reversed cleanly into valley folds without tearing paper fibers.
criteria.observable_indicator: Crease polarity matches diagram: convex ridge vs concave trough.

criteria.name: Crease sharpness & paper flatness
criteria.description: Folds burnished with fingernail or bone folder to 180-degree flat profile.
criteria.observable_indicator: Flap thickness profile compressed; zero springback.

practice_task.title: Fold Perfect Crane Bird Base
practice_task.instructions: Using 15cm kami paper, fold preliminary square, pre-crease side wings, and open into diamond bird base with symmetrical petal flaps.

criterion_results.observed_finding: Initial preliminary square corners had 2.2mm offset.
Left wing crease kept as mountain fold instead of popping into valley trough, crumpling central apex.
Folds left unburnished, flap springing open 25 degrees.

feedback.summary: Targeted corrective feedback for the next attempt.

items.what_was_observed: Did not reverse the lateral fold polarity; paper fought the fold and crumpled.
items.what_differed: Did not reverse the lateral fold polarity; paper fought the fold and crumpled.
items.corrective_advice: Pinch the side edges inward while pressing index finger behind paper to invert the mountain ridge into an inward valley.

criterion_results.observed_finding: Both lateral folds cleanly inverted into concave valley troughs; zero crinkling.

lineage.adaptation_notes: Sequential step-by-step 3D origami vector state sequence prevented fold crinkling.
